Package com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent

Class WebSearchToolParams

java.lang.Object
com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.WebSearchToolParams
All Implemented Interfaces:
ToolParams
public final class WebSearchToolParams extends Object implements ToolParams
Immutable parameters for a built-in web-search tool.

Unset parameters are omitted. The database validates required fields and tool-specific rules, allowing this model to represent partial updates. Additional parameters are retained for newer database releases.

Since:
1.1.0

    • toMap

      public Map<String,Object> toMap()
      Returns parameters using database JSON field names.

      SDK implementations return immutable maps, including nested values. Additional parameters appear alongside known parameters, without an extra wrapper property. Implementations supplied by callers are snapshotted by ToolAttributes.Builder.toolParams(ToolParams).

      Specified by:
      toMap in interface ToolParams
      Returns:
      parameter map; never null
